justification: Standard: changes a production unique index so banded Housing Code standards can be stored; no rows are changed by the migration itself.

pre_impl.existing_data: cdc_eligibility_standards held 4 active housing_code rows (eligible_zones, min_lot_size, acid_sulfate_max_class, min_lot_width), none with a band.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Migration 058 assumed one value per standard type; the Housing Code has 75 values over 23 types, banded by lot area or width and split by clause.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Replaces the existing index cdc_standards_one_active with a wider one of the same name; no new table or column.

falsifiable_check.command: python -c "import os,psycopg2;from dotenv import load_dotenv;load_dotenv('.env');c=psycopg2.connect(os.environ['DATABASE_URL']).cursor();c.execute(\"select count(*) from cdc_eligibility_standards where code_name='housing_code' and is_active\");print(c.fetchone()[0])"
falsifiable_check.fails_when: The count is not 79, meaning the banded rows were not stored or the old rows were lost.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: With the 058 index the load failed: duplicate key (housing_code, max_height_m). After 117 the load inserted 75 and the count is 79.

functions.name: cdc_standards_one_active (unique index)
functions.input: an insert of an active Housing Code standard with its band and clause
functions.output: accepted when no active row has the same type, band and clause
functions.if_none: a row with no band and no clause is compared as an empty band and empty clause, as before

queries.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cdc_standards_one_active ON cdc_eligibility_standards (code_name, standard_type, COALESCE(conditionality,''), COALESCE(ref_number,'')) WHERE is_active
queries.if_none: an index with no rows is valid; it only constrains future inserts
queries.purpose: allow one active standard per type, band and clause instead of one per type
queries.where_clause: WHERE is_active, so inactive history rows are never constrained

break_it.scenario: Two active rows for the same type, band and clause are inserted.
break_it.how: the unique index still covers type, band and clause
break_it.repro: insert a duplicate of any loaded row

break_it.scenario: An existing reader expects one row per standard type.
break_it.what_happens: It could read the wrong band.
break_it.how: the 75 new rows use 23 types that do not overlap the 4 types existing readers ask for

break_it.scenario: The index must be rolled back.
break_it.what_happens: The old index cannot be rebuilt while banded rows are active.
break_it.how: rollback steps in the file header; deactivate the 75 rows first

post_merge.manual_verify: Already applied to production 2026-10-23; count of active housing_code rows is 79.
